We need to parse the problem (Arabic). Mike was messaging with 5 people as friends via messaging. He stopped messaging with two of them. So remaining active correspondents = 5 - 2 = 3 people.

Each one sends him two messages per week, each message consists of 5 pages. And he replies to them in the same way (i.e., he also sends two messages per week to each, each 5 pages). So total pages he writes per week per person = he writes 2 messages * 5 pages = 10 pages per week per person. For 3 persons, total pages = 3 * 10 = 30 pages per week.

He can write a page every 6 minutes. So total minutes = 30 pages * 6 minutes = 180 minutes. Convert to hours: 180 / 60 = 3 hours.

Thus answer: 3.
